title.welcomeMessage: Elara is still under development. Some features may not work as expected. Please report any bugs you find!

editor.deployTooltip: Deploy the code to the rover
editor.resetTooltip: Reset back to the original code

tutorial.howToRunCode: Press "Deploy" and then "Play" to run your code. The code will cause the rover to move around and do things.
tutorial.whereToFindObjectives: Look at the "Objective" panel on the right side of the screen to see what you need to do.
tutorial.howToSeeErrors: If your code has errors, they will show up in the "Errors" panel at the bottom of the screen.
tutorial.backToHub: Click the "Back" button or press Escape to go back to the hub and select a different level.
tutorial.howToViewFunctionList: Click the "Functions" button to see a list of all available functions.
tutorial.extraChallenges: After completing a level, try the optional challenge for extra difficulty!
tutorial.movingTakesEnergy: Moving takes energy. Keep an eye on the energy meter!
tutorial.howToGetMoreEnergy: Collect energy cells to get more energy.
tutorial.showHintsAndDialog: If you're stuck, try clicking the "Hints" button for help.
tutorial.howToPauseAndStep: Use the "Pause" and "Step" buttons to run your code one line at a time.
tutorial.hoverOverText: Hover over code to see tooltips explaining what it does.
tutorial.hoverOverBoard: Hover over objects on the board to learn more about them.

errors.missingSemicolon: Syntax Error: Missing semicolon ';' at end of line.

errors.functionDisabled: Error: The {{funcName}} function is disabled for this level
errors.functionWrongArgs: Error: The {{funcName}} function should have {{argDesc}} as an input.
errors.functionNotFound: Error: There is no function named {{funcName}} (maybe you made a typo?)
errors.unterminatedString: Error: String is missing a quotation mark at the end.
errors.unexpectedLineBreak: Syntax Error: Unexpected line break inside function call. Try putting the function arguments on the same line.
errors.unexpectedSpaceInVarName: Syntax Error: Variable names cannot contain spaces. Use underscores instead (e.g., my_variable).
errors.unexpectedSpaceInFuncName: Syntax Error: Function names cannot contain spaces. Use underscores instead (e.g., my_function).
errors.missingClosingParen: Syntax Error: Missing a closing parenthesis ')' for the {{funcName}} function.
errors.missingParentheses: Syntax Error: Missing parentheses '()' after function name '{{funcName}}'.
errors.extraParentheses: Syntax Error: Extra set of parentheses '()'.
